mods.name: turn-timer
mods.description: A band above the prompt with how long the current turn has run (turn 0:42). It shows while a turn runs and hides between turns.

mods.name: ahead-behind
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the commits ahead and behind the upstream (↑2 ↓1), read with git status after each Bash call and file edit. Hidden when the branch has no upstream.

mods.name: battery-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the Mac battery percent and charging state (🔋 87%, ⚡ 54% while charging), read from pmset once a minute. Hidden on other systems.

mods.name: now-playing
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the track Music or Spotify plays on your Mac (♪ Song - Artist), asked through osascript once a minute. Hidden when nothing plays.

mods.name: ci-band
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (ci passed, ci failed, ci running), asked of the gh CLI every 2 minutes. Hidden without gh.

mods.name: todo-count
mods.description: A band above the prompt with how many lines in tracked files hold TODO, FIXME or HACK (todo 12), counted with git after edits. Hidden when there are none.

mods.name: cache-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the share of prompt tokens the cache served this session (cache 87%). A high share means cheaper, faster turns.

mods.name: streak-flame
mods.description: A band above the prompt with your daily streak, the days in a row you finished a turn (🔥 5d). The mod keeps the count in its own store.

mods.name: creator-band
mods.description: The creator band in one row above the prompt: turn timer, count of TODO, FIXME and HACK lines (read with git), and the daily streak flame.

mods.name: ops-band
mods.description: The ops band in one row above the prompt: commits ahead and behind the upstream (git), the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (gh), and the Mac battery (pmset).
